description: SRUP - Telecomunicações is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Direção-Geral do Território. Service and Public Utility Restriction (SRUP) - Telecommunications, in force in mainland Portugal. The constitution of easements and restrictions of public utility related to Telecommunications (radioelectric services) follows the regime provided for in the law, being included in the scope of Infrastructures. Coverage: Direção-Geral do Território. The portal shows the English title as "SRUP - Telecommunications" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Direção-Geral do Território. Its keywords include em-vigor, cartografia-oficial, point, infomapaccessservice, srup, snig-dgterritorio-gov-pt. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
